question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"A speech delivered without preparation"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given statement refers to a speech delivered without preparation.
 
• The correct word for this is **"Extempore"**, which means something spoken or done without prior preparation. (बिना तैयारी के)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked him to deliver an extempore speech on environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interment** (दफनाना): The act of burying a dead body in a grave.

 
 
• **Example:** The interment ceremony was attended by close family and friends.
 
 
 
• **Funeral** (अंत्येष्टि): A ceremony held to honor and bury or cremate a deceased person.
 
 
• **Example:** The entire community came together to attend the funeral of the village elder.
 
 
 
• **Rebellion** (विद्रोह): An act of violent or open resistance to an established government or ruler.
 
 
• **Example:** The rebellion was eventually suppressed by the military forces.
